eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following areas: Beauregard, LA; at 7:37 PM on AUG 26, 2023 Effective until 7:37 PM AUG 27, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Beauregard Parish Sheriff's Office is ordering a mandatory evacuation for areas east of Seth Cole Road north and south of Highway 190W through to Williams/Vigor Myers Road Maul Road Willie Hargrove Road and all near by streets roads and communities due to the wildfire. This notice affects all residents and businesses in this area. We are strongly encouraging you to heed this evacuation order. If you need a place to shelter there is one open and available at the First Baptist Church on the east side of DeRidder.
